instruction: A culture starts with 7 cells. Every hour each cell splits into 3 cells. How many cells are there after 45 hours? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. For this instance, let q denote the integer quantity requested above. Report q + 44320 instead of q. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
